candidate_transition.source: the exact 0805 candidate-after archive, applied temporarily to the 0806 production base by the root coordinator
candidate_transition.adoption_condition: this cross lane alone grants neither production adoption nor workflow advancement; the 0806 main packet owns the global decision after all benefit, resource, correctness, custody, and review gates pass

scope: Fresh DOCX/XLSX regression veto for the shared litchi-opc and litchi-ooxml-common reader graph; no new production cases, no timing pool with 0794 or any earlier packet, and no replacement of the 0806 main benefit/resource policy (0805 supplies only the candidate preflight)

qualification.purpose: verify the eight corpus/runtime oracles before the candidate transition; do not pool its timing

custody.binary: each copied executable and harness report records matching path, byte count, sha256, release profile, and executable identity
